description: Universal Event Tracking requests to the Microsoft Advertising collection endpoint.

params.name: ti
params.description: It is the numeric UET tag ID. Microsoft documents ti as required on every event.
params.fix_hint: Copy the UET tag ID from Microsoft Advertising into the tag snippet.

params.name: ver
params.description: It is the UET tag version. Microsoft documents ver as required, and 2.3 for a custom implementation.
params.fix_hint: Send ver as 2.3 on a custom implementation, or the version the generated snippet reports.

params.name: evt
params.description: It names the event. Microsoft documents evt as required, and only pageLoad or custom.
params.fix_hint: Send evt=pageLoad on a page view, or evt=custom on a custom event.

params.name: mid
params.description: It identifies events from a single page. Microsoft documents mid as a unique identifier that must change when the page changes.
params.fix_hint: Send a fresh mid per page, such as a GUID.

params.name: rn
params.description: It is a cache buster. Microsoft documents rn as a required random 6-digit number.
params.fix_hint: Send a random 6-digit rn on every fire.

params.name: p
params.description: It is the page URL. Microsoft documents p on pageLoad events, and as mandatory when page URL remarketing lists are used.
params.fix_hint: Send the absolute page URL in p.

params.name: r
params.description: It is the referrer URL. Microsoft documents r on pageLoad events.
params.fix_hint: Send the absolute referrer URL in r, or omit it.

params.name: uid
params.description: It is a customer-defined logged-in user ID that stays the same across browsers and devices.

params.name: vid
params.description: It is a customer-defined anonymous user ID.

params.name: msclkid
params.description: It is the Microsoft Click ID. Microsoft documents it on every event. N is the documented value when cookies are blocked or no click exists.
params.fix_hint: Forward the _uetmsclkid cookie, or send N when there is no click.

params.name: ec
params.description: It is the custom event category. Microsoft documents ec on custom events, and forbids it on pageLoad.

params.name: ea
params.description: It is the custom event action. Microsoft documents ea on custom events, and forbids it on pageLoad.

params.name: el
params.description: It is the custom event label. Microsoft documents el on custom events, and forbids it on pageLoad.

params.name: ev
params.description: It is the custom event value. Microsoft documents ev as numeric, on custom events only.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as 42, not a currency string.

params.name: gv
params.description: It is variable revenue for conversion tracking.
params.fix_hint: Send a number such as 20.55, with no currency symbol.

params.name: gc
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of gv.
params.fix_hint: Send the three-letter code, such as USD.

rules.message: A pageLoad event carries a custom-event field. Microsoft documents ec, ea, el, and ev as custom-event parameters that cannot be used with pageLoad.
rules.fix_hint: Drop ec, ea, el, and ev from pageLoad, or set evt=custom.
